subject: ACK mrt_format_ok widening: n2r true-MRT accepts 10/25/43/65/70/80/90/94/115 per target (source-level), with the tile-buffer guard
body: n2r_render_targets_check + n2r_rt_format (nord2_metal_render.c ~l.219) pack RGB_RENDER_TARGET for 10,25,30,43,55,65,70,80,90,94,110,115,125; per-target BLEND via n2r_blend_build_format (tegu_blend_build_format) and FAU word 48+8*rt per the MULTI_TARGET contract is the frontend's (render_encoder sidecar blends). Bridge n2c_mrt_prepare uses n2r_bpp for spans. New since c6n: n2r refuses colour_buffer_allocation > 16384 bytes per 16x16 tile (sum tib_bytes*samples*256; tib for 43 is 4 bytes): e.g. 4x RGBA16F+RG16F fits. Host tests cover 70/80/115 MRT only; 25/43/65/90/94 MRT is source-level ACK, no host oracle yet, no device claim.
